S.FORM: == Michael Jordan == Michael Jordan sraral hya'ga sisyuw na NBA, wal malaxmisuq qaniy la. kawas tay 1963, ryax sa tay 2 nqu tay 17, Michael Jordan, squliq na Bunge'. qnxan nya Michael Jordan hya'ga minhtuw squ qalang na Brooklyn, New York. Michael Jordan maki tay kawas 1989 msqun ki Juanita Vanoy, maki tay kawas 2006 t'alax. pincyuwagan nya' Pzyux qu wayal niya' kirok ni Michael Jordan. ryax qnxan nqu Michael Jordan sa senmung pgnawgan mari'. plpgun ingalan nya' tinsu' minxal ga 30.1 teng. min 6.2 zningat nya' mari'zik na ttkran mari'. min 5.3 qu rnaw nya' magal tensu'. min 5 mspung sa pzyang balay maki' yunaw na sinsyuw na NBA.
